excerpt: Start from an idea, or bring a company you already run. AFK handles the operational busywork either way.
Every task — incorporation, banking, payroll, cap table — runs in the same workspace, on autopilot.
Query and act across Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe, and more from a single surface. No tab-switching, no copy-pasting between dashboards.
Tell us your entity type, state, and headcount. AFK builds a tailored ops plan for your actual situation, not a generic checklist.
AI pre-fills forms using context it already knows — your EIN, addresses, founder details. You confirm or correct.
Set a goal like "Get to $1m ARR" and AI decomposes it into tasks — revenue modeling, cohort analysis, KPI alerts, milestone tracking — and asks only when it needs a human decision.
Reads run automatically. Writes pause for sign-off. Cost-incurring actions show estimates. You control the boundary between autonomous and supervised.
Every task becomes a directed graph of steps. Parallel branches run concurrently. Blocked nodes resume automatically when dependencies clear.
Scoped OAuth tokens, encrypted secrets, automatic key rotation, and full audit logs. Every action is traceable, every permission is minimal.
Shared company context across your team. Role-based access controls, delegated approvals, and a single source of truth for every operational decision.
